about: All flights of the Asia 2027 full draft (coordinator output; see SCHEMA.md §5). Times are LOCAL at each airport and come from the 2026 timetables (2027 schedules are not published yet); every segment's uncertainties are listed. Airports are canonicalised from seed/airports/airports.json by IATA.

flights.label: Outbound · ANA NH159 JFK → HND (Business, Aeroplan award)

segments.note: Departs 02:00 on Sat Oct 2 = leave home Fri Oct 1 evening (be at JFK T7 by ~23:30 Fri). Per person: 85,000 Aeroplan (= 70,834 Chase UR with the 20% transfer bonus) + CA$80.

flights.note:
**Award plan (Action Timeline row 3):** ANA releases seats 355 days out at 09:00 JST = **Sun Oct 11 2026, 8:00 PM ET**. Search 2 passengers in Business first; if only 1 seat, fall back per the ranked list (1F+1J same flight, 2F, …). Book as one 2-passenger booking when two seats show.

- Arrival ~05:00 at Haneda: immigration + customs ~1–2 h, then breakfast at Haneda Airport Garden (owner's Day 1).
- Forward big bags to the Tokyo hotel by takkyubin from the arrivals hall.
- Backup departure dates (Oct 3 / 9 / 10) stay in the Action Timeline.
uncertain: Times from the 2026 summer timetable (JFK 02:00 → HND 05:00; one source lists 05:15). The 2027 timetable is not published.
JFK Terminal 7 as of 2026; T7 is due to close as JFK's new terminals open — confirm ANA's terminal nearer the date.
HND arrival terminal: FlightStats lists T2 for NH159 (ANA also uses T3 for international) — confirm.
The coordinator task text said 'Aeroplan 75k'; the sheet (USA to Asia Flights row 3) says 85k Aeroplan + CA$80 for ANA Business — the sheet value is used.

flights.label: Osaka → Seoul · Korean Air KE726 KIX → ICN

segments.note: Allow 3 h at KIX: Japan's refund-type tax-free system (since 2026-11-01) means customs checks your tax-free purchases at departure — keep passport, receipts and the goods (unused) in carry-on reach.

flights.note:
- **Tax refund:** at KIX go to the customs tax-refund check BEFORE security with passport + purchases; the refund then goes back to the card.
- Namba → KIX: Nankai *rapi:t* (reserved, ~38 min) — leave Namba by ~15:00.
- ICN T2 → Seoul Station: AREX Express ~43 min (or AREX all-stop ~60 min); last express ~22:40.
- Alternative: KE724 12:35 → 14:25 (787-10) if you'd rather have a Seoul evening than an Osaka afternoon.
uncertain: 2026 timetable (KE726 KIX 18:15 → ICN 20:05, daily); 2027 times not published.

flights.label: Busan → Ho Chi Minh City · Vietnam Airlines VN423 PUS → SGN

segments.note: Korea tax refund: kiosks/counters in the PUS international terminal (or instant refund in-store). Vietnam e-visa must be approved before this flight.

flights.note:
- Haeundae → Gimhae Airport by taxi ~40 min (leave ~07:30).
- SGN T2 → District 1 by Grab ~30–45 min.
- Codeshare KE5687. VietJet also flies PUS–SGN (5×/week) if cheaper.
uncertain: 2026 timetable (VN423 PUS ~10:05 → SGN 12:55); 2027 times not published.

flights.label: Ho Chi Minh City → Da Nang · Vietnam Airlines VN132 SGN → DAD

segments.note: Domestic: SGN Terminal 3. Pick a fare with checked baggage (Economy Lite fares may exclude it).

flights.note:
- District 1 → SGN T3 by Grab ~30–40 min (leave ~11:30).
- DAD → Hoi An by car/Grab ~45 min; hotel ~16:00, then **order the tailoring on day 1** (suits, overcoats, trench coats, ao dai) so there's time for 2+ fittings.
- Earlier alternative: VN122 10:00 → 11:20 or VN126 11:00 → 12:20 (more Hoi An time, less HCMC morning).

flights.label: Da Nang → Hanoi · Vietnam Airlines VN174 DAD → HAN

segments.note: Tailored clothes add weight: buy an extra checked bag if needed.

flights.note:
- Morning: final tailor fitting + pickup in Hoi An, leave ~14:30 (car ~45 min to DAD).
- HAN T1 → Old Quarter by taxi ~45 min.
- Earlier alternative: VN172 13:45 → 15:10.

flights.label: Hanoi → Taipei · EVA Air BR398 HAN → TPE

segments.note: Vietnam VAT refund counter at HAN T2 (registered stores, invoices ≥ VND 2 million) before security.

flights.note:
- Old Quarter → HAN T2 by taxi ~45 min (leave ~09:15).
- TPE T2 → Taipei Main Station: Airport MRT express ~38 min.
- Alternative: China Airlines CI792 11:30 → 15:20.

flights.label: Home · Turkish TK25 TPE → IST + TK29 IST → EWR (Business, United award)

segments.note: One United award covers both segments: 110,000 miles per person + taxes. Taiwan tax refund (TRS) counter at TPE before check-in.
Arrival shown in EST (US clocks go back at 02:00 on Nov 7); the summer timetable is 18:50 → 22:30 EDT.

flights.note:
**Award (Action Timeline row 7):** Turkish via United, ~110k per person, 3+ seats seen; United loads ~337 days out (≈ early Dec 2026).

- Taipei → TPE: Airport MRT express ~38 min; leave Taipei Main Station by ~18:30.
- **~13 h 40 m in Istanbul (05:10 → 18:50):** Turkish Business Lounge, or Touristanbul (free city tour for transfer passengers with 6–24 h connections) / TK hotel desk if eligible — check the rules when booking.
- Faster alternative if the award prices it: TK3 IST 07:20 → JFK (≈2 h connection) instead of TK29 to Newark.
- TK29 runs 6×/week (not Thursdays); Sun Nov 7 is a flying day.
uncertain: 2026 timetables: TK25 TPE 21:45 → IST 05:10+1 (787-9); TK29 IST 18:50 → EWR 22:30 EDT (summer).
TK29 arrival 21:40 EST is derived from the summer block time after US DST ends on 2027-11-07; the winter timetable may differ.
Taxes for a TPE-origin United award are an estimate (the sheet's $13.70 is for EWR-origin).

todos.text: Transfer Chase UR → Aeroplan before the 20% bonus ends
todos.note: DEADLINE (Action Timeline row 2): ~200k Chase → 240k Aeroplan covers every ranked ANA option.

todos.text: ANA award seats for Oct 2 open — book NH159 JFK→HND (2× Business via Aeroplan)
todos.note:
Opens 09:00 JST = 8:00 PM ET the evening before (7 PM ET after Nov 1). Ranked options (Chase points with the bonus):
1. 2 Business, same flight — ~141.7k
2. 1 First + 1 Business, same flight — ~170.8k
3. 2 First — 200k
4. 1 First + 1 Business, different flights — ~170.8k
5. 2 Business, different flights — ~141.7k
Search 2 passengers in Business first; two seats → one 2-passenger booking.
